why_we_race.title: Why We Race
why_we_race.jcr:description:
Performance under pressure defines both cybersecurity and world-class racing. Speed, agility, and resilience are critical when staying ahead of rapidly-evolving threats, on and off the track.

CrowdStrike, in partnership with AWS, convenes C-level cybersecurity leaders at premier race weekends around the world to explore how operational excellence and teamwork drive sustained performance in high-stakes environments.
